item.title: UNICEF: Gaza children are threatened with disease, with cold and lack of supplies
item.description: The United Nations Children’s Fund (UNICEF) warned of a growing risk of disease outbreaks among children in the Gaza Strip, given the cold weather and the impact of storms on the territory, amid a severe shortage of basic supplies.
